title: Positive Bribe Tail Indicator
statement: Let $k,m$ be nonnegative integers with $m>0$, and let $y\in\{−1,1\}^m$. The indicator that the majority function with bribe $1$ returns $1$ at $y$ equals the indicator that $m^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^m y_j>-(k+1)/\sqrt m$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ is a sign vector of length $m$
